digest.component_or_area: test suite - transport and pagination verification
propositions: Five confirmed tests have assertions that cannot fail and must be rewritten to actually test their documented contracts
PAT credential must be prevented from appearing in transport repr() output, requiring a transport that carries the credential and actual __repr__ implementation testing
Pagination structural guard test must call the shared audit helper with optional source parameter instead of re-implementing the AST walk inline, so mutations to the predicate cause test failure
validate_assignee_exists must be asserted to return username string (not bool or accountId) for DC and accountId (not username) for Cloud backends
Rate-limit retry test must assert exactly one client call per member (not <=1) and catch BackendHTTPError with code==429, not blanket Exception
